bar.text: ...SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY IN EFFECT THROUGH TUESDAY MORNING... Combined seas 12 to 14 ft falling to 10 to 12 ft later this morning, further falling to 9 to 10 ft this evening. Bar conditions rough. Maximum ebb currents will occur around 400 AM Monday, 415 PM Monday, and 445 AM Tuesday. The afternoon ebb on Monday will be strong.
